audit_findings: The four NPC PNG canvases are 35×44; visible alpha bounds are 20×33/34 for the male NPCs and 19×34 for Gunda. Compare visible body proportions, never padded canvas height.
Native NPCs use compact bodies, separately readable short legs, dark stepped outlines and coherent material clusters. A single Verren silhouette cannot define all clothing.
Bookshelf and barrel are historical prop images with individual dimensions, not a universal prop grid or tile scale.
Frid garden screenshot is environmental context only; its apparent pixel scaling and age forbid treating screenshot pixels as native dimensions.
Portraits (74×100) must not justify full-body or head/body scale.
Sample includes three male village professions and one female peasant-style NPC (Gunda); armored guards, seated poses and directional consistency remain unverified.
